title: Customs Duty Drawback, Tariff Refund & Antitrust Claim Recovery — Practitioner Testimony Operator Workbook
subtitle: A field-tested recovery workbook for drawback eligibility, claim execution, IEEPA refunds, Section 301 and AD/CVD exposure, bond sizing, ACE portal reporting, ACH refund setup, entry summaries, post summary corrections, and the CBP protest and court ladder

worksheets.title: Drawback Lookback and Claim Readiness Audit
worksheets.purpose: Size the five-year drawback opportunity, choose the right claim type for each product family, prove the import-to-export trace, and decide whether filing clears the cost hurdle before you commit leadership time, provider fees, or a privilege application to Customs.
instructions: Pull five years of import entries and export records before writing anything, because first-time claimants can reach back five years from import.
Complete the fields in order; the one-shipment trace and export scrub must be finished before any waiver of prior notice or accelerated payment application.
Cite the practitioner source for every rule you rely on, and mark any number that is your own estimate rather than a reported figure.
Stage a mock audit of your own documentation so you know where every record and data element lives before Customs asks in a desk review.
If projected recovery minus administrative expense and provider fees is not positive, record that result and stop rather than filing.

fields.name: import_export_profile
fields.prompt: Describe your import-to-export flow in plain operational terms: which products you import, which you export or destroy, which HTS numbers they share, and whether exports run through your own entity or through a customer, partner, or domestic supplier relationship.
fields.example: We import China-origin housings that carry Section 301 duty and export finished units to Canada, while a domestic distributor exports items under the same HTS number. Practitioners say Customs refunds 99% of duties, taxes, and fees on goods later exported or destroyed, keeping 1% [Connecticut District Export Council — bOFLeOBOaF0 @ 00:06:41], so both flows are mapped as drawback candidates.

fields.name: five_year_lookback_estimate
fields.prompt: Estimate the total duties, taxes, and fees paid on eligible imports over the past five years, then state what share you believe is recoverable. Note who in leadership must see the number and what assumption about company size might be blocking action today.
fields.example: Five-year lookback shows roughly $1.4 million in duties and fees on goods later exported. Evana notes that mid-sized companies assuming drawback is only for big companies find this number gets the CFO's attention [Evana — 6bp1bi4-zH4 @ 00:03:47]. With 70-80% of eligible drawback going unclaimed each year [USA Customs Clearance — QX8vx-rrO4A @ 00:00:52], the CFO briefing is scheduled first.

fields.name: drawback_type_selection
fields.prompt: Identify which drawback path fits each product family: unused merchandise traced by direct identification, substitution of commercially interchangeable goods, or destroyed merchandise. Explain the records you hold for each and why that path beats the alternatives for this inventory.
fields.example: Unused merchandise drawback covers imported goods exported or destroyed without being used, traced to the export by direct identification [Scarbrough Global — E-PQ2z_UoCM @ 00:00:25]. Our spare parts fit that path. Mixed warehouse stock moves to substitution, which practitioners call especially powerful for commercially interchangeable goods under the same HTS [USA Customs Clearance — khfmXSwD3DE @ 00:02:48].

fields.name: hts_substitution_match
fields.prompt: List each import HTS number alongside the export HTS number you plan to substitute against. Flag 'other' lines that must match at 10 digits, any 'other other' lines that are barred, and show the lesser-of value comparison for every substituted pair.
fields.example: Import line and export line match at 8 digits, so substitution holds. One 'other' line was pushed to 10 digits and one 'other other' line was dropped. Because you can only claim drawback on the lesser of the import or export value when substituting [Alliance Duty Drawback Services — mkogoOMopss @ 00:03:26], each pair shows both values and the lower figure claimed.

fields.name: ineligible_duty_screen
fields.prompt: Separate every duty type paid on candidate entries into recoverable and non-recoverable buckets. Record Section 301 and 201 amounts separately from Section 232, antidumping and countervailing, and over-quota duties, and note any lines where practitioners disagree on eligibility.
fields.example: Thompson Hine's Aaron Mandelbaum states the 99% refund on duties, fees and taxes [Thompson Hine LLP — WqGvMD-AOqg @ 00:05:44], and Section 301 and 201 sit in the recoverable bucket. Section 232 steel duties, AD/CVD deposits and over-quota amounts are moved to a non-recoverable tab, since AD/CVD goods sit outside drawback entirely and are never modeled into the forecast.

fields.name: one_shipment_trace
fields.prompt: Pick one representative shipment and trace it from purchase order to import entry, through inventory movements, to the export record. Note each document, system, and owner along the path, and where the import record fails to tie back to export.
fields.example: Trace of one March container runs PO, entry summary, receiving log, pick ticket, and export bill of lading. Customs grants waiver of prior notice off this trace [Connecticut District Export Council — bOFLeOBOaF0 @ 00:31:30]. The gap sits at receiving, matching the warning that claimants miss by not tying the import record back to the export record [Scarbrough Global — VcD4-UlsOzk @ 00:03:06].

fields.name: export_proof_scrub
fields.prompt: Describe how you will test the export database against hard-copy export documents before filing. List the foreign-to-foreign moves, cancelled orders, and short shipments removed, and explain how courier proof-of-delivery records are archived as shipments move rather than at claim time.
fields.example: A sample of 200 export lines was tested against hard copies, and 14 foreign-to-foreign moves plus 6 short shipments were scrubbed [International Trade Council — O5a8FOALaXk @ 00:52:22]. Courier proof-of-delivery files are now saved weekly because those records expire [Flexport — 1_L7fnmAAU0 @ 00:27:04], and desk reviews typically catch companies on proof of exportation [International Trade Council — O5a8FOALaXk @ 00:43:11].

fields.name: returns_and_destruction_controls
fields.prompt: Explain how open retail returns are physically separated from unused drawback stock and Canada or Mexico exports, and how any planned destruction will be scheduled, witnessed by a disinterested third party, and documented with a certificate before goods are destroyed.
fields.example: Open returns now receive red stickers, a separate zone, and an '-R' SKU suffix so they cannot contaminate unused drawback or Canada/Mexico exports [Flexport — 1_L7fnmAAU0 @ 00:29:29]. Damaged stock waits for a scheduled, witnessed destruction event with a certificate, because Customs often denies destruction claims when there is no proof the destruction was supervised [Scarbrough Global — lsd6_oB4p00 @ 00:02:29].

fields.name: partner_claim_structure
fields.prompt: Map any supply chain partners whose exports or imports could support a joint claim. State the quantity actually sold between you, how confidential pricing will be shielded through an intermediary or NDA, and what incentive, if any, partners will receive.
fields.example: Our importer partner hands imports to us for a joint claim capped at the quantity sold between us under a commercial relationship [Simply Trade Podcast — 3N8L-IKPY4A @ 00:17:10]. Pricing runs through an NDA'd middleman so neither side sees the other's documents, with about 10% per claim offered [World Trade Center Denver — SO9sA-x5K0k @ 00:39:02]. Selling unused credits is rejected as noncompliant.

fields.name: go_no_go_economics
fields.prompt: Weigh projected recovery against administrative filing expense and provider fees. Record the fee percentage quoted, any provider minimum, the accelerated payment timeline you expect, and the exact day the privilege application and first claims will be filed together.
fields.example: Provider quotes 10% of recovery, a good starting point per Nogueiras [International Trade Council — O5a8FOALaXk @ 00:59:22], while CEDA's $250K floor would refer us elsewhere [World Trade Center Denver — SO9sA-x5K0k @ 00:28:03]. Accelerated payment approval may take 120 days before claims pay in about 30. Privilege application and claims file the same day to lock the five-year clock.

worksheets.completion_gate: Gate cleared only when the five-year lookback is sized, every claimed duty is confirmed recoverable, one shipment traces cleanly from purchase order to export, the export database reconciles to hard copies, and the recovery math is positive after fees and administrative expense.

worksheets.title: IEEPA Refund, Section 301 and AD/CVD Exposure Map
worksheets.purpose: Confirm who owns the IEEPA refund, map every entry by liquidation status against the refund and protest clocks, file clean CAPE declarations once, and measure the antidumping, countervailing, and bond liabilities that can erase a refund if left unchecked.
instructions: Confirm importer-of-record status in ACE before spending a dollar on services, counsel, or financing.
Pull the ES003 report and build one master entry list; every later field draws from that list.
Treat every CAPE declaration as final, because an accepted filing cannot be amended.
Calendar every liquidation date and the 180-day protest window the same day the entry list is built.
Size bond and AD/CVD exposure at the higher tariff rate so the refund case is not undone by a liability you did not model.

fields.name: ior_status_confirmation
fields.prompt: State which legal entity appears as importer of record on each entry, how you confirmed it in ACE, and whether any sister company, DDP supplier, or carrier actually holds that role. Note any entity you assumed was not the importer.
fields.example: ACE confirms our company is importer of record on 412 entries, and a subsidiary appears on 37 more. Maguire has seen more businesses that were the importer of record and did not know it than the reverse [Lutz — 6Y30Cf9AeYE @ 00:26:17], and CAPE accepts requests only from the importer or authorized broker [The Wax Seal — mL-p627SkkI @ 00:02:28].

fields.name: es003_entry_pull
fields.prompt: Describe how you pulled the ES003 report, the date range covered, the number of IEEPA-hit entries found, and how the result was reconciled line by line against any refund filing your broker already made. Flag entries the broker list missed.
fields.example: ES003 covering 2025 forward was pulled from our own ACE account and matched against the broker's filed list. Opscale Exchange describes a free ES003 review that found an extra $1 million on top of a $2.1 million filing the client's own broker had missed [Opscale Exchange — t98WTC5Cm9o @ 00:16:56], so 23 unmatched entries were escalated before any declaration.

fields.name: liquidation_status_map
fields.prompt: Sort every IEEPA-hit entry into unliquidated, inside the 80-day window, and liquidated buckets. For each bucket record the refund path, the protest deadline counted 180 days from liquidation, and whether an entry-specific court order will be required. Note the owner responsible for each deadline.
fields.example: Unliquidated entries go through CAPE or PSC, and anything outside the 80-day window is pushed into protest or court before the 180-day protest clock expires [Tariffs Lawsuit — DOHCXtY_zI0 @ 00:03:14]. For older liquidated entries, CBP says it needs an entry-specific court order [Freightos — cIMBwZ9J60I @ 00:00:58], so those 41 entries were routed to counsel.

fields.name: ach_bank_readiness
fields.prompt: Record the US-bank, USD-denominated ACH routing and account details loaded in ACE, who entered them, who independently verified them, and the date. Note whether any refund would otherwise route through a 4811 or notify party instead of directly to you.
fields.example: Controller loaded routing and account numbers in ACE and treasury verified them against the bank letter. Practitioners report about $737 million was still trapped because importers had not given Customs their bank details [Finn's Fine Print — Pf2fDVQXfmk @ 00:03:45], and a wrong account number sends the refund into the void for months [Ask The Customs Manager — NRCd8c6t8rY @ 00:02:13].

fields.name: cape_declaration_quality
fields.prompt: List the validation checks you will run on each CAPE declaration before submission, including entry numbers, formatting, banking setup, and reused entries. Explain who signs off, and how you will avoid errors that cannot be fixed after acceptance.
fields.example: Only about 70% of declarations passed initial validation, so roughly one in three failed at the door [Tariffs Lawsuit — DOHCXtY_zI0 @ 00:02:08]. Because an accepted CAPE declaration cannot be amended [Tariffs Lawsuit — DOHCXtY_zI0 @ 00:02:26], our checklist compares each entry number with the 7501, confirms ACH setup, blocks reused numbers, and requires a second reviewer's signature.

fields.name: court_route_decision
fields.prompt: Decide whether to file a protective suit at the Court of International Trade for any entry group. Record the dollar value at stake, the counsel consulted, the expected cost, and why waiting on the administrative route is or is not acceptable.
fields.example: Tariffs Lawsuit encourages filing in the Court of International Trade so you are a party before Judge Eaton, who can order the refund immediately [Tariffs Lawsuit — dWEik4YquEE @ 00:00:35]. CSIS panelists warn the Justice Department is banking on small importers not bothering [Center for Strategic & International Studies — PJpF0M_rjYs @ 00:26:15], so the liquidated group above $400,000 goes to counsel.

fields.name: service_and_financing_vetting
fields.prompt: List every refund service, law firm, or buyout financier that has approached you. Record their fee structure, whether any upfront payment is requested, the buyout price offered per dollar of claim, and why you accepted or declined each offer.
fields.example: One firm demanded an upfront fee and was declined, since Border & Bench calls that a red flag and Leyton charges only a percentage after CBP pays [Border & Bench — Zq36LwbWWJc @ 00:08:45]. A buyer offered 60 cents on the dollar; buyout pricing moved from about 22 cents to 55% to 75% of claim value [Commercial Funding Marketplace — LaWXf8aLv1o @ 00:03:29].

fields.name: tax_and_pass_through_plan
fields.prompt: Model the after-tax value of the expected refund, including any depreciation basis that unwinds on capitalized equipment. Then document whether customers, distributors, or shoppers are asking for a share, and what your contracts actually require you to pass through.
fields.example: On capitalized equipment at a 30% rate, a $300,000 refund can be worth about $210,000 once the depreciation basis unwinds [Lutz — 6Y30Cf9AeYE @ 00:23:03]. Two distributors requested a share, but the refund belongs to the importer of record, and no court order or Customs rule requires pass-through [PolitiClash — uhEb06Zt2cw @ 00:09:01]; only contract terms are reviewed.

fields.name: adcvd_scope_screen
fields.prompt: Screen every product made of metal, wood, paper, plastics, or chemicals against the written AD/CVD scope language and registers. Record the ABI query results at both 8 and 10 digits, and any item needing a binding scope ruling before shipping.
fields.example: Our aluminum brackets cleared at 0% on a 10-digit query, but the 8-digit query surfaced an AD/CVD flag that 10-digit queries miss [NCBFAA Educational Institute — CGsvr1SDN8s @ 01:19:50]. With penalty duties running 50% to over 300%, as with a $50K aluminum container drawing a $150K bill [Ask The Customs Manager — Ze1pOvT4KsI @ 00:01:18], a scope ruling is requested.

fields.name: bond_sufficiency_check
fields.prompt: Recalculate continuous bond sufficiency from a rolling 365-day forecast of duties, taxes, and fees at the higher tariff rate plus a buffer. Record current bond size, required size, the next size you will jump to, and who carries residual liability.
fields.example: Bond sufficiency is annual DTF times 10%, $50K minimum [Trade Risk Guaranty — M68ZVWdgp9I @ 00:02:15]. Forecast DTF near $95 million plus a 5% buffer exceeds a $7M bond, and one-size bumps fail nine times out of 10, so we start at $10M. The surety pays up to the bond amount while we remain liable to it [Trade Risk Guaranty — P-dHB1oQLCI @ 00:02:12].

worksheets.completion_gate: Gate cleared only when importer-of-record status is confirmed, US-bank ACH details are loaded, every entry carries a liquidation status and deadline, CAPE data is validated before submission, AD/CVD scope is checked at 8 and 10 digits, and bond sufficiency is recalculated.

worksheets.title: ACE Portal, Entry Summary and Protest Ladder Control Sheet
worksheets.purpose: Stand up your own ACE account, register ACH refunds, pull the ES-001 and ES-003 reports, keep every CBP request inside its response window, and package entry summaries, post summary corrections, protests, and court filings so no deadline or dollar slips away.
instructions: Sign up for the ACE portal regardless of size; it is the central hub across all brokers that holds an electronic 7501.
Load bank information inside the portal itself before any refund is expected, and double-check routing and account numbers.
Switch CF28 and CF29 delivery to the portal before working through the report and correction fields.
Treat the 7501 as the shipment's tax return: every supporting document must tell the same story, and the importer of record owns the numbers.
Calendar the 180-day protest date, the 30-day deemed denial date, and the 180-day CIT summons date the moment each trigger occurs.

fields.name: ace_account_setup
fields.prompt: Document your ACE Secure Data Portal setup: the company and importer-of-record data used in the application, the trade account owner, where the shared secret is stored, and the recovery plan if the account locks after failed login attempts.
fields.example: We applied with company and IOR data, then unlocked the account with the shared secret, now held in the controller's vault. Three failed attempts lock the account, and a locked-out TAO calls the ACE helpdesk with the shared secret [Shapiro — 605kfE-oUPM @ 00:05:23]. Scarbrough Global encourages signing up regardless of size [Scarbrough Global — GuV2m_XHyd0 @ 00:04:08].

fields.name: ach_refund_registration
fields.prompt: Confirm that refund bank details are registered inside the ACE portal itself, not assumed from paying duty by ACH or periodic monthly statement. Record the verification step, the date, and any refund currently routed through a 4811 or notify party.
fields.example: Since February 6, 2026, CBP stopped paper refund checks for all refund types, with waivers described as rare [Ask The Customs Manager — NRCd8c6t8rY @ 00:00:00]. We had paid duty by periodic monthly statement and wrongly assumed that registered us; bank information must be loaded in the portal itself [Scarbrough Global — P1YIRCE3BPQ @ 00:10:34]. Treasury entered it Tuesday.

fields.name: es_report_pull
fields.prompt: Describe the ES-001 and ES-003 line-tariff pulls and Web Intelligence queries you run, the date range covered, how IEEPA lines and liquidation dates are flagged, and how post summary corrections are captured in the same report view. Note who reruns the pull each month.
fields.example: ES-001 and ES-003 pulls cover 2025 forward. Following Shapiro, the standard report was parked in Favorites with Save As before editing, then the PSC indicator was dragged in so corrections appear in the same pull [Shapiro — 605kfE-oUPM @ 00:20:16]. The liquidation date column tracks the 180-day protest deadline [BGI Worldwide Logistics, Inc. — zVrENO4RtLw @ 00:02:26].

fields.name: cf28_delivery_settings
fields.prompt: Record how CF28 requests for information and CF29 notices of action reach you today, who receives them, and the date delivery was switched to the portal. Explain how each 30-day response window is calendared and owned on the day it arrives.
fields.example: A CF28 arrived by mail three weeks late, leaving only five days of the 30-day window, and non-response leads to a CF29 rate advance [Scarbrough Global — P1YIRCE3BPQ @ 00:05:32]. Delivery is now set to portal plus mail, the compliance lead owns every request, and a backup reviewer checks the portal each Monday and Thursday.

fields.name: credit_authorization_check
fields.prompt: If you pay CBP directly by credit, describe how each payment is authorized, who confirms authorization on every entry, and what control prevents a forgotten step. Note any entries already penalized and how the penalty was resolved or is still pending.
fields.example: Scarbrough Global reports a $1,000 per entry penalty when importers paying CBP direct by credit forget to authorize, with about a dozen penalized yearly [Scarbrough Global — P1YIRCE3BPQ @ 00:28:53]. Our AP clerk now authorizes within one day of each entry summary, and the controller reviews a weekly list of unauthorized entries before close.

fields.name: psc_strategy
fields.prompt: List entries needing a post summary correction, the error being fixed, who will file it through an ABI connection, and whether a pending 232 or 301 exclusion justifies requesting an extension of liquidation instead of fighting through protest later.
fields.example: Importers cannot file a PSC without an ABI connection, and the PSC filer does not have to be the entry filer [Scarbrough Global — 52Q7Sv1KF4Q @ 00:14:18], so a second broker files ours. With a 301 exclusion pending, we asked the center team for an extension of liquidation and will file a PSC once granted [U.S. Customs and Border Protection — lGkujBtNI0A @ 00:04:52].

fields.name: form_7501_review
fields.prompt: Walk one entry summary block by block under the 2026 layout. Confirm values exclude DDP duties, each MID matches the actual manufacturer, invoice and packing list descriptions agree, and new melt, smelt, and cast country blocks are completed for 232 articles.
fields.example: The February 2026 revision moved 23 of 43 block numbers and added blocks 21-24 for melt, smelt, and cast countries [CustomsPrep — Customs Broker License Exam — qORXZ_TDyKg @ 00:00:20]. Our review stripped duties from DDP values to avoid paying twice [Law Office of Yuri Starikov, LLC — 1DFXItS5lCQ @ 04:00:13] and hand-checked every MID against the actual factory.

fields.name: protest_packaging
fields.prompt: Describe how each protest will be packaged in ACE: the lead entry listed first, how entries with similar exclusions are grouped, the 10-digit HTS and Chapter 99 numbers cited, and the specific because statement supporting any further review request.
fields.example: CBP's protest team reported filings jumping from about 28,000 a year to 93,000 in 2020 and urges grouping entries with similar exclusions [U.S. Customs and Border Protection — lGkujBtNI0A @ 00:50:18]. Our protest lists the lead entry first and cites 10-digit HTS plus Chapter 99 numbers, while each entry keeps its own proof because there is no blanket claim.

fields.name: court_escalation_ladder
fields.prompt: Map the escalation ladder for each denied or stalled protest: the 180-day protest date, any accelerated disposition request and its mailing method, the deemed denial date, proof that all duties and interest are paid, and the CIT summons deadline.
fields.example: Accelerated disposition was sent separately by certified mail, and the protest is deemed denied after 30 days [U.S. Customs and Border Protection — lGkujBtNI0A @ 01:04:12]. The 180-day summons date is calendared from denial, and our void-denial request is treated as a side bet because it does not toll that clock [U.S. Customs and Border Protection — lGkujBtNI0A @ 01:01:36]. All duties are paid.

fields.name: records_isf_cape_capture
fields.prompt: Describe where every entry document is retained and for how long, how ISF filings are confirmed correct and on time, how entry type codes are checked, and how every IEEPA-hit 7501 is captured before any CAPE declaration is submitted.
fields.example: Every document is kept five years [VoraPrep — 2rbdaN1Swhk @ 00:05:04], and ISF filings are checked daily because filing correctly and on time is not optional [JSJ INTERNATIONAL LCB — 2cuZPxRLr1E @ 00:07:42]. Before declaring in CAPE, all IEEPA-hit 7501s are captured, since a missed entry means a new declaration at the back of the queue [NextGen CPA — sMBX0ZlgJRY @ 00:01:10].

worksheets.completion_gate: Gate cleared only when ACE access and ACH bank details are verified, report pulls capture every IEEPA-hit 7501, CF28 delivery runs through the portal, credit authorizations are current, 7501 data reconciles to invoices and packing lists, and every protest and CIT deadline has a named owner.

worksheets.title: Classification and Valuation Defense Log
worksheets.purpose: Build a defensible HTS classification and customs value for every product line before entry, so the importer of record can prove the code was derived from tariff language, notes, and GRIs, and that the declared value reflects the lowest lawful price actually paid or payable.
instructions: Describe each product by material, function, construction, and use before opening the tariff schedule, and never classify straight from the alphabetical index.
Read legal notes as mandatory text, apply the GRIs in order, and log at least three candidate headings with the reason each was eliminated.
Treat every supplier or vendor code as an unverified lead and re-derive the code yourself, because the importer of record owns the code and the penalty exposure.
Pull every Chapter 99 overlay before trusting a base rate, then run the full duty math, including MPF and HMF, against a worked benchmark.
Test transaction value and first sale eligibility against the full paper trail, including contracts, factory invoices, bank transfers, and additions, before any declaration is made.

fields.name: product_physical_profile
fields.prompt: Describe the imported product strictly by material, function, construction, and intended use rather than by its marketing or product name. List every physical detail that could move the tariff rate, such as wall construction, insulation, fiber content, or power source, before searching any heading.
fields.example: Stainless steel drinking vessel, 750 ml, double wall with vacuum insulation, screw lid, sold for hot and cold beverages. Insulation is the deciding construction detail: USA Customs Clearance notes a single-wall stainless steel bottle runs about 2.9% while a vacuum-insulated flask runs 7.2% [USA Customs Clearance — MfmhZLeMz2w @ 00:02:33]. Product name 'Adventure Flask' is ignored for classification.

fields.name: candidate_headings_log
fields.prompt: Record at least three candidate headings you considered, the legal note or GRI step that eliminated each one, and the specific product details that decided the final heading. Note how indentation on the page established the hierarchy you followed.
fields.example: Heading A eliminated after reading the chapter legal notes as mandatory text; heading B eliminated because a semicolon in the tariff text was treated as a full stop, closing that branch; heading C selected on construction. Star USA, Inc. advises always keeping a log of headings considered and why each was eliminated [Star USA, Inc. — ygZWIWKWe4w @ 00:48:03].

fields.name: supplier_code_rederivation
fields.prompt: Enter the HTS code your supplier or vendor provided, then the code you re-derived independently from tariff language, notes, and GRIs. Explain any difference and confirm you did not copy a competitor's code or take the first CROSS hit.
fields.example: Vendor code differs from the re-derived code at the 6th digit and appears to reflect the origin country's variation. Flexport's trade advisory team says vendor codes are incorrect 99% of the time [Flexport — 2Z2HUuGsrFI @ 00:12:20], and Star USA, Inc. stresses customs only cares that the right HTS is used [Star USA, Inc. — HbhpILTp9v0 @ 00:56:12]. Re-derived code governs.

fields.name: duty_digit_and_chapter99_overlays
fields.prompt: Confirm the 8th digit that sets the duty rate, separate from the two statistical digits, then list every Chapter 99 overlay that may stack on the base rate, including Section 122, 301, and 201 exposure, before trusting any 0% figure.
fields.example: Base line shows 0%, but the lookup displays a slash and underscore after the rate, signaling added tariffs. Shipping Solutions shows a 0% base line can carry eight possible Chapter 99 overlays [Shipping Solutions — _I3v11oKRLA @ 00:03:45]. Duty set at the 8th digit per Star USA, Inc. [Star USA, Inc. — -v_-OQnVlxE @ 01:01:37]; Section 301 overlay confirmed and logged.

fields.name: duty_calculation_worksheet
fields.prompt: Show the full landed duty math for one shipment: quantity, unit value, base duty, Chapter 99 additions, and the Merchandise Processing Fee and Harbor Maintenance Fee. Compare your total against a worked benchmark so arithmetic errors surface before the entry is filed.
fields.example: Benchmark: Supplyia Sourcing lands $697.14 total duty on 5,000 umbrellas at $2 each, including MPF and HMF [Supplyia Sourcing — ff_P7M6LKEo @ 00:14:41]. MPF applied at .3464%, minimum about $26, maximum $508, on both air and ocean [Supplyia Sourcing — ff_P7M6LKEo @ 00:04:24]. Our own shipment total is then recalculated line by line and matched to the customs broker's figure.

fields.name: binding_ruling_decision
fields.prompt: State whether a binding ruling will be requested before importing, who will request it, and when. If you will not seek one, explain why the classification risk is acceptable given that the importer of record carries the penalty exposure.
fields.example: Binding ruling requested by a licensed professional during product development, before the first purchase order ships. Cole International calls a binding ruling the definitive assessment [Cole International — x-SDVKIzJdI @ 00:02:26]. Broker liability is limited to the entry fee, often $100 or less [Steve Fodor — Exy48YwwPtk @ 00:35:38], so the importer of record cannot shift the classification risk onto the broker.

fields.name: transaction_value_basis
fields.prompt: Document the price actually paid or payable that forms your transaction value, itemizing any middleman markup embedded in that price. Explain whether transaction value is the correct method for this lane and identify every dollar of markup currently being taxed.
fields.example: Invoice price from the trading company is $10 per jacket; the Vietnam factory price is $7, so $3 of markup is currently in the duty base. Flexport notes transaction value drives 90 to 95 percent of import valuations [Flexport — yR_RXKhapxo @ 00:09:13], and declaring the factory price would cut liability 30 percent [Ask The Customs Manager — 5fk-EKpR8Zw @ 00:01:26].

fields.name: first_sale_eligibility
fields.prompt: Test the first sale against each condition: arm's length, bona fide, goods clearly destined for the US at manufacture, and the middleman taking title at a separate point in time from the importer. Note any flash title risk and the staggered FOB points.
fields.example: First sale is FOB Shenzhen and second sale is FOB Hong Kong, so title passes at different delivery points rather than simultaneously. Flexport warns that simultaneous FOB Hong Kong transfers are flash title and customs has often rejected them [Flexport — yR_RXKhapxo @ 00:15:27]. Contract language was reviewed beyond the Incoterm to confirm when the middleman owned the goods [Flexport — yR_RXKhapxo @ 00:44:21].

fields.name: first_sale_paper_trail_and_additions
fields.prompt: List the documents in hand proving the first sale price, including the original factory invoice, factory purchase order, and bank transfer. Then describe how assists, royalties, and proceeds of subsequent sale reach the broker on every entry.
fields.example: Original factory invoice, factory purchase order, and the bank transfer showing the middleman paid the factory price are filed together with every entry packet [Ask The Customs Manager — 5fk-EKpR8Zw @ 00:02:16]. An additions pipeline is stood up first so assists, royalties, and proceeds of subsequent sale flow to the broker before each filing [Flexport — yR_RXKhapxo @ 00:34:06]. Gaps block the declaration.

fields.name: import_record_intelligence
fields.prompt: Summarize what bill-of-lading research revealed about competitors, suppliers, or buyers on this product line. Note any shipments masked by a freight forwarder, how the true shipper was surfaced, and whether reverse data from destination countries filled gaps.
fields.example: A competitor's master bill showed only a freight forwarder; scrolling to related bills of lading and clicking the house bill surfaced the true shipper and consignee [ImportGenius — 9IaKZ1JUPmU @ 00:05:51]. Taiwanese suppliers shipping into the US were identified through destination-country import data [💎Kiona 職場 x 行銷筆記💎 — i3e313EJJPE @ 00:00:46]. US ocean freight data omits price, so pricing was benchmarked separately.

worksheets.completion_gate: Do not file an entry until every product line has a re-derived HTS code with a three-heading elimination log, a full Chapter 99 overlay check, a duty calculation reconciled to the broker, and a valuation file containing the factory invoice, purchase order, bank transfer, and additions record for any first sale claim.

worksheets.title: Structural Mitigation and Audit-Ready Compliance Plan
worksheets.purpose: Design duty mitigation structures that pay only when built before goods hit the border, including foreign trade zones, bonded storage, returned goods relief, and tariff engineering, and pair them with an internal audit program that keeps every refund filing able to stand up to CBP scrutiny.
instructions: Model each foreign trade zone savings bucket separately and exclude any benefit that has ended, such as the inverted-tariff option under privileged foreign status.
Confirm the original importer of record that paid the first duty before any 9801 return or refund claim, and never let a sister company file on its behalf.
Lock classification and binding rulings during product development, because misdeclaring or reclassifying after entry is fraud.
Audit entries on a fixed cadence against the 7501, target at least a 95% pass rate, and clean IOR records, bond status, and 5106 fields before any refund filing.
Sequence CAPE uploads from cleanest to riskiest entries, and get any prior disclosure on file before CBP issues a notice.

fields.name: ftz_fit_assessment
fields.prompt: Assess whether a foreign trade zone fits your profile: import volume, share from non-FTA countries, export share, scrap, and entry count. State whether you would own a zone or use a 3PL FTZ network, and estimate each savings bucket.
fields.example: Modeled against Rebecca Williams's $50M importer: scrap $60K, exports $100K, one-time deferral $460K, inverted tariff $800K, weekly entry $187K against $2M baseline duty [Montana World Trade Center — xWFmdLRN9Ro @ 00:38:53]. CNBC reports the inverted-tariff option has ended under privileged foreign status, so that bucket is excluded. A 3PL FTZ network avoids capital and compliance burden [Radial — p-c3zl1yoVk @ 00:01:40].

fields.name: bonded_storage_timing
fields.prompt: Identify containers or SKUs where a rate spike makes immediate entry costly, and describe whether you will hold goods in a bonded warehouse or zone until the expected rate settles. Record the expected rate difference and the decision owner.
fields.example: Two footwear containers are held in bonded storage rather than entered during the spike, following the Deer Stags approach of expecting 30% instead of 125% on a held container [CNBC — KFKpVuWoQLU @ 00:11:52]. Duty is deferred until goods leave storage. Decision owner: import operations manager, reviewing rates weekly with the broker before releasing either container for entry.

fields.name: returned_goods_9801_file
fields.prompt: For goods that may return, confirm the 3-year window, that no value was added abroad, and that no drawback was claimed on export. List the serial numbers, manufacturer plate photos, and original export declaration number prepared for the carrier.
fields.example: Medical instrument demo units coded 9801.00.1055, returning within 3 years with no work done abroad and no drawback claimed on export. Plates photographed and serial numbers captured before export, since a 9801 claim was denied without them [JSJ INTERNATIONAL LCB — W-f4Ah72J_I @ 01:33:40]. Original export declaration number goes to the carrier up front [Ask The Customs Manager — GdCve47uHF8 @ 00:01:21].

fields.name: original_ior_confirmation
fields.prompt: Name the legal entity shown as importer of record on the original Form 7501 that paid the first duty. Confirm that same entity, not a sister company or affiliate, will file any 9801 return claim or tariff refund request.
fields.example: Original Form 7501 lists the parent operating company as importer of record; the distribution affiliate is excluded from filing. JSJ INTERNATIONAL LCB recounts a sister company that sank five trailers [JSJ INTERNATIONAL LCB — W-f4Ah72J_I @ 00:23:23], and TrackIQ confirms only the Form 7501 importer can claim IEEPA refunds [TrackIQ — Q8jgNmiJNZg @ 00:00:59]. Affiliate staff may support data pulls but never sign.

fields.name: tariff_engineering_plan
fields.prompt: Describe any tariff engineering change under consideration, confirming it happens during product development before importation. Explain the construction or material change, the target rate, and how you will avoid artificial product splitting or assuming one ruling covers other products.
fields.example: Seasonal decor redesign evaluated at the prototype stage, using Flexport's example of snow globes moving from 7.2% to 0% only when engineering happens before importation. Classification and a separate binding ruling for each variant locked during development [JSJ INTERNATIONAL LCB — OyJAzze4KyY @ 00:04:37]. No reclassification after entry, since JSJ calls misdeclaring or reclassifying after entry fraud [JSJ INTERNATIONAL LCB — OyJAzze4KyY @ 00:05:39].

fields.name: entry_audit_program
fields.prompt: Define your internal entry audit program: sample size, cadence, pass-rate target, and the fields checked on each entry. Explain how country of origin and payables are verified against the 7501 rather than taken from secondary sheets such as the ISF.
fields.example: Monthly spreadsheet audit of sampled entries with a target pass rate of at least 95% [Shapiro — cjNgBgUI1As @ 00:02:32]. Country of origin is never taken from the ISF sheet, and payables are checked against the 7501 on every audited entry [Shapiro — cjNgBgUI1As @ 00:40:59]. A $250 to $300 ITRA is ordered to expose unauthorized filers using the importer number.

fields.name: ior_record_hygiene
fields.prompt: Record the results of your bond query and ACE importer view review: importer of record name, physical and mailing addresses, bond number, bond status, and Form 5106 contact fields. Note whether an IRS 147C letter is on file.
fields.example: Bond query and ACE importer view confirm the IOR, addresses, bond number, and active, sufficient status [Trade Risk Guaranty — PymimTwXXVM @ 00:04:25]. The 147C letter was requested at 1-800-829-0115, pressing 3, around 6:30 Central [Trade Risk Guaranty — PymimTwXXVM @ 00:07:27]. Red-asterisk email and phone fields are confirmed monthly in ACE directly, since a broker bond query cannot show them.

fields.name: prior_disclosure_assessment
fields.prompt: List any errors found during the audit that could support a prior disclosure, and confirm no CBP notice has yet been issued on those entries. Identify who decides on filing and the date the disclosure must be on file.
fields.example: Audit found origin errors on three entries traced to ISF data; no CBP notice has been issued, so a prior disclosure remains available [VoraPrep — xq7kXAXH3GQ @ 00:06:20]. VoraPrep describes the mechanism as the system's way of encouraging people to come clean and fix their own mistakes [VoraPrep — xq7kXAXH3GQ @ 00:05:10]. Compliance counsel files before any refund declaration.

fields.name: cape_upload_readiness
fields.prompt: Before any CAPE CSV upload, confirm each entry's classification, origin, and value are clean, because the checkbox attests to them and the upload pushes entries into liquidation, barring further PSCs. Rank entries from cleanest to riskiest for sequencing.
fields.example: Tier 1 entries with verified classification, origin, and value go first; Tier 2 entries wait on corrections. Grassi warns the CSV upload pushes entries into liquidation and bars further PSCs [Grassi — xA8LxqtatDo @ 00:13:07], and advises putting the 6% refund interest toward an audit while filing the cleanest entries first [Grassi — xA8LxqtatDo @ 00:23:40]. Only about 63% of Phase 1 declarations passed.

fields.name: penalty_mitigation_strategy
fields.prompt: If a penalty or seizure notice arrives, outline the mitigation arguments available, such as inability to pay, first offense, or CBP's own errors. Identify whether counsel or a broker leads the response and how privilege is preserved.
fields.example: Counsel leads any penalty response, using first-offense status and documented CBP errors as primary arguments. Jennifer Diaz reports a $4M penalty reduced to $4,000 using inability to pay, first offense, and CBP's own errors [Meaningful Mediation — OFX0_mQm-Qo @ 00:15:49]. IEEPA Tariff Watch notes a broker can file paperwork, but an attorney can protect your rights [IEEPA Tariff Watch — V9_1adwF1c8 @ 00:04:52].

worksheets.completion_gate: Do not upload a CAPE file, claim 9801 treatment, or apply for zone status until the original importer of record is confirmed, the latest entry audit meets the 95% pass-rate target, IOR and bond records are verified in ACE, and any prior disclosure has been filed or ruled out in writing.

worksheets.title: Broker Oversight and Settlement Claim Recovery Tracker
worksheets.purpose: Verify that every customs broker acts under a direct, properly scoped power of attorney with demonstrable supervision, benchmark broker economics and bond sourcing, and capture every antitrust and class action settlement dollar through legitimate, honestly documented claims filed before the deadline.
instructions: Confirm a direct power of attorney covers every commodity each broker clears, and have it signed before goods sail from origin.
Verify duty remittance yourself, because the importer of record stays liable if the broker fails to pay CBP.
Benchmark broker fees and bond premiums against market bands, and buy the continuous bond direct from a surety where it saves money.
Inventory every settlement your business or household may qualify for and file through the official site, since unfiled claims are forfeited money.
Estimate claim quantities from records, upload proof, and reject any notice or service that demands upfront payment, gift cards, crypto, or a Social Security number.

fields.name: poa_scope_verification
fields.prompt: Confirm a direct, properly executed power of attorney exists for each broker, covering every commodity being cleared. Note the signing date, whether it was in hand before goods sailed from origin, and whether any scope expansion requires an amended POA.
fields.example: Direct POA with the ocean broker covers electronic components only; the new monitor line needs an amended POA, since VoraPrep calls exceeding POA scope a major compliance failure [VoraPrep — 8NkJbs7UVvY @ 00:07:18]. POA signed and returned before the first shipment sailed, because even a basic ISF filing needs it [Scarbrough Global — m-RN8tPLnPk @ 00:01:25]. Relationship confirmed in writing.

fields.name: broker_duty_remittance_check
fields.prompt: Describe how you verify that your broker actually remits duties to CBP on each entry, and how you would detect a missed payment. Note whether you pay CBP directly, use periodic monthly statements, or authorize credit payments yourself.
fields.example: Monthly ACE statement review matches every broker invoice to a CBP-posted payment, because the importer of record stays liable if the broker fails to pay [Steve Fodor — NXnGUZwargM @ 00:04:42]. Periodic monthly statement status moves payment to the 15th business day of the following month [Steve Fodor — NXnGUZwargM @ 00:07:31]. Direct credit payments are authorized to avoid $1,000-per-entry penalties.

fields.name: broker_fee_benchmark
fields.prompt: List every line item on your broker invoice, separating entry fees from pass-through charges such as the Merchandise Processing Fee. Compare the entry fee to market bands for standard and complex work, and flag any add-on services you cannot justify.
fields.example: Standard ocean entry billed at $225, inside the $150-250 band; complex entries at $380, inside $250-400 [Factory Floor Economics — YhiuYAa1Byw @ 00:06:06]. MPF passed through at 0.3464% with a FY2027 minimum of $34.58 and maximum of $670.86. Broker margin typically lives in add-on services, so each add-on line is questioned before payment is approved by finance.

fields.name: continuous_bond_sourcing
fields.prompt: Record your continuous bond amount, annual premium, and whether it was purchased directly from a surety or through the broker. Explain how the bond amount was sized and when it will next be reviewed against trailing duties, taxes, and fees.
fields.example: Continuous bond bought direct from a surety at roughly $400-500 a year, rather than through the broker [Ask The Customs Manager — DHSVYPVM3bA @ 00:01:43]. Sized at 10% of trailing annual duties, taxes, and fees with a $50K floor [Trade Risk Guaranty — M68ZVWdgp9I @ 00:02:15]. Reviewed quarterly; the next increase skips intermediate sizes rather than stepping up one size at a time.

fields.name: broker_supervision_evidence
fields.prompt: Summarize the written evidence your broker provided of responsible supervision and control: training already conducted with topics and hours, a compliance manual that is actually followed, record retention practice, and the 72-hour cyber breach reporting procedure.
fields.example: Broker supplied training logs with topics and hours, mirroring what a permit application must prove [Braumiller Law Group, PLLC — 9rfRsbrSbPw @ 00:07:01]. The broker's manual is followed, since a broker is better off with no manual than one ignored [CONECT Recorded Webinars — jMlTHY21lng @ 00:57:18]. Records kept in the US for 5 years; our import team also adopts the 72-hour breach practice.

fields.name: corrective_advice_log
fields.prompt: Log any corrective advice your broker has shared about classification, valuation, or entry errors, including the date, the issue, and the action taken. Note whether the advice was documented internally, reported onward, or still awaits a decision from your team.
fields.example: Broker flagged an invoice and packing list conflict, cotton versus polyester, on two entries and recommended reconciling before filing, because blind reliance on the importer is a major violation [VoraPrep — 2rbdaN1Swhk @ 00:05:53]. CONECT panelists say sharing corrective advice with the client shows reasonable care [CONECT Recorded Webinars — jMlTHY21lng @ 00:46:26]. Advice documented internally and both entries corrected before filing.

fields.name: settlement_eligibility_inventory
fields.prompt: List every antitrust or class action settlement your business or household may qualify for, such as interchange, ATM fee, Blue Cross, or data breach cases. For each, record the official settlement site, claim deadline, and whether you hold a unique ID and PIN.
fields.example: Gas-station ATM fee case: $167.5 million fund [Receipts — UvphNI0Wxog @ 00:04:53]. AT&T data breach: up to $7,500 with uploaded proof [Crazy Deals and Steals — IP9zniHMMKM @ 00:00:55]; ID and PIN recovered by searching email for Kroll plus breach keywords. Merchant interchange claim filed through PaymentCardSettlement.com. Only 4% of eligible consumers file, so every listed case gets a claim.

fields.name: claim_estimate_and_proof
fields.prompt: Show how each claim quantity or loss estimate was built from records such as old bank statements or spreadsheets. Remember the form is signed under penalty of perjury, so note what proof you uploaded and what backup you retain for administrator follow-up.
fields.example: ATM fee count built from bank statements, not a guess; Receipts warns that claiming a daily gas-station ATM visit since 2007 invites a follow-up letter [Receipts — UvphNI0Wxog @ 00:06:51]. Blue Cross Option B filing attaches Excel spreadsheets showing allowed-amount calculations [Horty Springer & Mattern, P.C. — jgkO88qEcMs @ 00:13:57]. All supporting statements are archived for later administrator requests under the perjury attestation.

fields.name: notice_legitimacy_screen
fields.prompt: Screen every settlement notice, check, or claim-filing service for scam signals: upfront fees, gift card or crypto requests, Social Security number demands, or contingency charges. Record how you confirmed legitimacy with the administrator named on the official letter.
fields.example: Unexpected check verified by emailing the administrator listed on the perforated letter before deposit [The Class Action Attorney — wR6-BeiQppQ @ 00:01:54]. A notice requesting payment was discarded, since News4JAX calls any payment request in a class action a scam [News4JAX The Local Station — kOG09tYsDhM @ 00:00:46]. A 25% contingency pitch for merchant interchange claims was declined because free filing methods exist.

fields.name: recovery_routing_decision
fields.prompt: For each recovery route, decide whether to file directly, use an intermediary, or opt out. Record expected net proceeds after attorney fees and administration costs come off the top, and confirm importer-of-record status before pursuing any consumer tariff pass-through refund.
fields.example: Blue Cross provider claim filed directly; Horty Springer models about 24% of the $2.8 billion to plaintiffs' lawyers and about $200 million to costs [Horty Springer & Mattern, P.C. — jgkO88qEcMs @ 00:03:38]. No tariff pass-through claim is pursued, because CAPE accepts requests only from importers of record or authorized customs brokers [The Wax Seal — mL-p627SkkI @ 00:02:28]. Unfiled claims are forfeited money.

worksheets.completion_gate: Close this worksheet only when every broker holds a direct, correctly scoped POA with documented supervision, duty remittance is verified against ACE, the bond is sized and sourced, and every eligible settlement has a filed claim with record-based estimates, uploaded proof, and administrator-confirmed legitimacy.
